title: Equity & Power Dynamics (CommUniversity course)
description: A six-week live online course from the Foundation for Intentional Community, taught by Jahia de Rose, on how equity and power show up inside intentional communities — across class and wealth, national origin, language, race, gender, and ownership stakes — and what to do about it. Covers foundational equity principles, communication strategies, transformative governance models, conflict navigation, and tactics for redistributing power, in everyday language. Each class is recorded and posted within 24 hours, with a discussion group for participants. Paid: prices on the course page start from $80, with $120 also listed.

recurrence.schedule: Six Wednesdays, 10am-12pm CT, on Zoom: October 28; November 4, 11, and 18; December 2 and 9, 2026 (no class on November 25).
